items.html: And behold, he is now fit for coupling, for the secret of all the couplings is to sweeten the Gevurot of the female with the Hassadim of the male, and he already has Hassadim in his Daat, to draw from there a drop through coupling, to place them within the Yesod of the Nukva, in which are the five Gevurot. Therefore the coupling is called by the language of Daat, in the secret of "and Adam knew his wife." And this is the secret mentioned in the Gemara: "A minor from nine years and one day — his intercourse is a valid intercourse." Unlike until now, when the aspects of the Mochin of the Tzelem were not completed in their places, nor his Daat; therefore he is still a complete minor and is not fit for coupling.
